errors.evidence: The description states the accuracy for TLDR on GSM8K is 86.4%. This is incorrect; 86.4% is the accuracy for Vanilla CoT on the next dataset, MATH500. The chart shows a change of -1.6% from Vanilla CoT's 92.5% on GSM8K.

The value 86.6% is not explicitly written on the chart. It is an interpretation calculated by adding the base value (86.4%) and the percentage point change (+0.2%). The description should only report what is visually present.
The description incorrectly states that both methods score 43.4%. The chart clearly indicates a '-0.1%' change for the TLDR method, meaning its score is 43.3%, not identical to the Vanilla CoT score.

The value 83.5% is not explicitly written on the chart. It is an interpretation calculated by adding the base value (79.6%) and the percentage point change (+3.9%). The description should only report what is visually present.
